locations.description:
**Solution:**
- Obtain the [S.T.A.R.S Badge](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-2-remake/maps/claire-b?locationIds=553243#L)
- Press a switch on the back to turn it into a USB Dongle Key
- Insert it into the PC, then interact with the nearby computer

locations.title: Clock Tower Puzzle
locations.description:
**Solution:**
- Put the [Large Gear](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-2-remake/maps/claire-b?locationIds=553362#L) in the [Gear Box](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-2-remake/maps/claire-b?locationIds=553088) to lower the stairs
- Take the [Small Gear](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-2-remake/maps/claire-b?locationIds=553389#L) from the gear box upstairs, and put it in the [Gear Box](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-2-remake/maps/claire-b?locationIds=553385#L)
- Put the Large Gear in the [Gear Box](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-2-remake/maps/claire-b?locationIds=553388#L) upstairs, and the [Power Panel Part](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-2-remake/maps/claire-b?locationIds=553359#L) will be yours!

locations.title: Electronically-locked Door
locations.description:
**Solution:**
- [Power Panel Part](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-2-remake/maps/claire-b?locationIds=553359#L) + [Power Panel Part](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-2-remake/maps/claire-b?locationIds=553391#L)
- Rotate the pieces so they resemble the screenshot above

locations.title: Picture Block Puzzle
locations.description:
This puzzle is partially random, but can be consistently solved in the same way.

**Solution:**
- Insert the [Picture Block](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-2-remake/maps/claire-b?locationIds=553394#L)
- Move the second block to the left by one spot
- Move the third block to the left by one spot
- Rotate the blocks until they form a complete sequence, as seen in the screenshot

locations.title: Chess Plug Puzzle
locations.description:
**Solution:**
- [Knight Plug](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-2-remake/maps/claire-b?locationIds=553445#L) in [Plug Socket 1](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-2-remake/maps/claire-b?locationIds=553437)
- [Rook Plug](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-2-remake/maps/claire-b?locationIds=553488#L) in [Plug Socket 2](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-2-remake/maps/claire-b?locationIds=553438)
- [Pawn Plug](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-2-remake/maps/claire-b?locationIds=553444#L) in [Plug Socket 3](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-2-remake/maps/claire-b?locationIds=553439)
- [King Plug](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-2-remake/maps/claire-b?locationIds=553471#L) in [Plug Socket 4](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-2-remake/maps/claire-b?locationIds=553440)
- [Bishop Plug](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-2-remake/maps/claire-b?locationIds=553443#L) in [Plug Socket 5](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-2-remake/maps/claire-b?locationIds=553441)
- [Queen Plug](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-2-remake/maps/claire-b?locationIds=553467#L) in [Plug Socket 6](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-2-remake/maps/claire-b?locationIds=553442)

locations.title: King & Queen Puzzle
locations.description:
**Solution:**
- Grab the [Queen Plug](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-2-remake/maps/claire-b?locationIds=553467#L) and slot it into [Plug Socket 9](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-2-remake/maps/claire-b?locationIds=553468)
- Go upstairs, grab the [King Plug](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-2-remake/maps/claire-b?locationIds=553471#L), then drop down.
  - A zombie will be lurking - watch out!
- Use the King Plug to unlock [Plug Socket 10](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-2-remake/maps/claire-b?locationIds=553472) and unlock the [One-Way Door](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-2-remake/maps/claire-b?locationIds=553473).
  - Grab the Spark Shot if you have the space!
- Reclaim both plugs; use them to power up [Plug Socket 8](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-2-remake/maps/claire-b?locationIds=553466) and [Plug Socket 7](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-2-remake/maps/claire-b?locationIds=553465).
- Go through Socket 7's door to reach the Queen plug. Take it, go back through the previous door, then take the King plug. Done!
